info.title: DeepStream VMS Backend
info.description: Control-plane API for the DeepStream multi-camera analytics platform. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/token and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description: Log out: this token stops working at once.
Change your own password. All your existing tokens (including this one) stop working: sign in again.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Auth Users Get

patch.description: Change role, enable/disable, or set a new password. Any of these logs the user out everywhere at once.

post.description: Log a user out everywhere (for example after a lost laptop). They can sign in again.
Clear a sign-in lockout (the user locked themselves out with wrong passwords).

Replace the camera's model assignments. Only this camera's pipeline is rebuilt;
other cameras (including the one sharing its worker) keep running.

schema.title: Response List Models Api V1 Models Get

put.description:
Update metadata, enable/disable, register a new version, or activate/roll back
to an existing version. Only cameras using this model get their pipelines rebuilt.

schema.title: Response List Workers Api V1 Workers Get

get.description: Capacity view: streams per GPU, pending cameras, and the live admission decision.

activate_version.title: Activate Version
activate_version.description: activate (or roll back to) an existing version
